notes.note: Re-recorded for #2970's final delta to the Windows service task: install sets no execution time limit (PT0S), both battery rules off, priority 5 and the scheduler's restart settings, reads all six back, and service status reports a task without them as stale; a comment now states the measured facts (Get-ScheduledTask reports PT72H by default; Task Scheduler does not rerun a wrapper that exits non-zero). This page's claims about the Windows service were re-read against that delta; only docs/reference/cli.md describes these settings and it was updated in this change.
